faq.answer_text: The examination is divided into 4 distinct domains covering business operations, private investigations, trial preparation, and professional and ethical responsibilities for all licensed candidates pursuing their credentials.
faq.question_title: How many domains are on the exam?

faq.answer_text: The examination has a strict duration of 120 minutes, giving all qualified candidates adequate time to answer questions across the designated test domains required for licensure.

methodology.summary: This informational page was constructed using official exam guides and documentation published directly by the California Bureau of Security and Investigative Services (BSIS).

editorial.overview: The Licensed Private Investigator Examination is officially certified by the California Bureau of Security and Investigative Services (BSIS) to thoroughly evaluate candidates across four core domains. It focuses on managing business operations, conducting detailed investigations, handling trial preparations, and maintaining professional and ethical standards over a strict duration of 120 minutes.
editorial.preparation_strategy: Review the official BSIS exam guides and study materials to prepare effectively. Focus your preparation on the four distinct exam domains, paying particular attention to investigation management, legal compliance, and ethical standards required for professional private investigators during the 120-minute testing window to achieve success.
editorial.who_should_take: Candidates seeking licensure as a private investigator or qualified manager through the California Bureau of Security and Investigative Services (BSIS) should take this exam to demonstrate operational and legal competence.
